## `neuro.bigInt64Array.sort`

Instance method on `BigInt64Array.prototype`.

> Sorts the array.

## Signatures

```ts
sort(input: { bigInt64Array: <receiver>; compareFn?: (a: bigint; b: bigint) => number | bigint; prompt?: string }): Promise<BigInt64Array>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `BigInt64Array.prototype.sort` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
